titleEn: Law on the Organization and Function of Supreme Council of National Defense

articles.en: The Supreme Council of National Defence is hereby established in order to ensure the protection of the Constitution, the protection of national independence, sovereignty and the territorial integrity of the Kingdom of Cambodia, and to ensure the performance of the roles, duties and competence of the Royal Cambodian Armed Forces, as well as to review and approve national defence policy and national defence plans.

The Supreme Council of National Defence shall have the following composition: - the King of the Kingdom of Cambodia, President; - the Prime Minister, Vice-President; - the Minister of National Defence, member; - the Minister of Interior, member; - the Minister in charge of the Office of the Council of Ministers, member; - the Minister of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation, member; - the Minister of Economy and Finance, member; - the Commander-in-Chief of the Royal Cambodian Armed Forces, member.

The King shall preside over the Supreme Council of National Defence. His Majesty shall have the Royal prerogative to appoint the Prime Minister as His Majesty's highest representative to preside over the meetings of the Supreme Council of National Defence.

-
The Supreme Council of National Defence shall have the following roles: - to ensure the protection of the Constitution of the Kingdom of Cambodia
- to ensure the protection of national independence, sovereignty and the territorial integrity of the Kingdom of Cambodia; - to ensure the neutrality of the performance of the roles, duties and competence of the Royal Cambodian Armed Forces; - to ensure the implementation of national defence policy and national defence plans.

.
The Supreme Council of National Defence shall have the following duties: - to review and approve national defence policy and national defence plans; - to provide necessary opinions on draft laws or proposed laws relating to the organisation of national defence and on the acceptance or denunciation of any conventions, treaties, international pacts and agreements in the military field; - to assess the situation for placing the nation in a state of emergency or war in order to proceed in accordance with the spirit of the Constitution; - to review and approve the plans and reports of the General Secretariat of the Supreme Council of National Defence.

..
The Supreme Council of National Defence shall hold an ordinary meeting at least 1 (one) time per year, upon the invitation of the King as President or of the Prime Minister as Royal representative through a Royal message delegating authority.
In necessary cases, the Supreme Council of National Defence may hold an extraordinary meeting at the request of the Prime Minister.

- The Supreme Council of National Defence shall have the right to invite ministers or senior representatives of the Royal Government and of relevant ministries and institutions to attend its meetings as necessary.

- The modalities and working procedures of the Supreme Council of National Defence shall be determined by the internal rules of the Supreme Council of National Defence.
The Supreme Council of National Defence shall have a General Secretariat as its support body.
The General Secretariat of the Supreme Council of National Defence shall be led by one Secretary-General, assisted by a number of Deputy Secretaries-General as necessary.
The Secretary-General and the Deputy Secretaries-General shall be appointed by Royal Decree or sub-decree.
The organisation and functioning of the General Secretariat of the Supreme Council of National Defence shall be determined by sub-decree.

.
Expenditure for the operation of the Supreme Council of National Defence shall be financed by the national budget separately within the budget of the Ministry of National Defence.

Any provisions contrary to this Law shall be considered null and void.
Done at Phnom Penh, 22 [month illegible] 2013, in the Royal name and by Royal command
